context: While building the batch-1 signoff packet for config/m2-step3-events.json, found a real same-day filing for PARR's 2025-05-06 candidate (0000821483-25-000014) that reports/m2-step3-same-day-catalyst-review-2026-10-01.json's own sweep did not catch.
methodology_gap_found: The original sweep (reports/m2-step3-same-day-catalyst-review-2026-10-01.json) matched same-day pairs on each candidate's recorded filing_date from config/m2-step3-frozen-candidate-ledger.json. For PARR's three candidates, EDGAR's own filingDate field lags the true release date by one calendar day whenever SEC acceptance happens after 5:30 PM ET (EDGAR's 'deemed filed next business day' rule): PARR 0000821483-25-000014 carries filing_date 2025-05-07, but the true release and SEC acceptance both happened 2025-05-06 (accepted 2025-05-06T21:45:55Z = 17:45:55 ET, after the 17:30 cutoff). A same-day 8-K filed and accepted earlier the same real day -- 0001437749-25-014660, Item 5.07, filingDate 2025-05-06, accepted 2025-05-06T14:28:24Z = 10:28:24 ET -- shares the true calendar day but not the recorded filing_date, so it fell outside the original sweep's matching key.
scope_of_gap: Confirmed this does not change PARR's other two step-3 candidates: 0000821483-24-000025 (true/accepted 2024-11-04, filing_date 2024-11-05 -- same deeming pattern, but no other PARR filing shares acceptanceDateTime 2024-11-04) and 0000821483-25-000002 (SEC acceptance itself happened the next calendar morning, 2025-02-26T14:41:29Z, not a same-evening deeming case, so filing_date and acceptance day coincide and the original sweep's key was correct for it). Not yet checked against the other 55 step-3 candidates outside batch 1 -- flagged below as a recommendation, not performed here.

new_same_day_catalyst_test_applied.competing_filing: 0001437749-25-014660, Item 5.07 -- Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders (2025 Annual Meeting, held 2025-05-01, results reported 2025-05-06 10:28 ET)
new_same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_dissemination: Read the filing's own cover and body directly (sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/821483/000143774925014660/parr20250505_8k.htm): no press release exhibit, no Item 7.01 Reg FD reference -- only the 8-K itself (director election and auditor-ratification vote tallies) and XBRL.
new_same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_content: Routine annual-meeting voting results (ten director nominees elected, Deloitte & Touche ratification) filed 5 hours before the 16:15 ET earnings release; a purely procedural, orderly, already-scheduled corporate-governance filing, not new information about the business.
new_same_day_catalyst_test_applied.reasoning: Fails conditions 2 and 3 -- no independent dissemination and no fresh, material content. Same category as this project's own established OKTA/CXT Item-5.07-and-5.02 precedent for orderly, non-business disclosures.
new_same_day_catalyst_test_applied.disposition_note: Not excluded on this basis. Full disposition still pending the corporate-action check, identity/exchange re-verification, and a label-engine dry run -- the corporate-action check and dry run already ran clean for this candidate (reports/m2-step3-batch1-signoff-packet-2026-10-02.json); identity re-verification is in that same packet.

recommendation: When batching candidates 2 through 6 of the remaining 55 step-3 candidates, match same-day pairs on each candidate's true release date (as independently verified per-candidate), not on the frozen ledger's filing_date field -- re-check any candidate whose own filing_date already differs from its verified true release date, the same way this gap was found for PARR.
not_a_claim: Does not mark PARR's 2025-05-06 candidate, or any other batch-1 candidate, 'included' -- see reports/m2-step3-batch1-signoff-packet-2026-10-02.json for what remains pending.
